newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican Energy cuts Iowa electric rates.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican Energy cuts Iowa electric rates.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Holdings Co said Monday it cut electricity prices for its Iowa residential customers by $10 million as part of a deal approved by the Iowa Utilities Board.
The cuts are being made under a plan proposed in June 1996 by MidAmerican designed to reduce and stabilize electric prices through the year 2000.

Prices were cut last November by $8.5 million and are to be cut by another $5 million on June 1, 1998. In addition, under the plan MidAmerican will not seek an increase in prices, excluding state-mandated program costs, before December 31, 2000, unless its earnings fall significantly below historic levels.

The plan was part of the merger which formed MidAmerican. Midwest Resources Inc and Iowa-Illinois Gas and Electric Co merged July 1, 1995 to form MidAmerican. MidAmerican said Iowa approved the plan on Friday.
MidAmerican provides electric service to 642,000 customers and natural gas service to 610,000 in Iowa, Illinois, Nebraska and South Dakota.
